name: Shittaka Niwaka
source:
Hayuru's junior. She manages the apartment complex in place of her grandmother, who's not feeling well.

The manager's office is directly below Nariyuki's room, so loud voices apparently carry through clearly.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698944]getchu[/url]]
